lookup.title: Find component online
lookup.find_online_hint: Fill in data from the Element14 / Mouser catalogs
lookup.placeholder: MPN or keywords (e.g. IRFZ44N, NE555 SOIC)
lookup.summary: {n} unique parts · click a row to use its data

lookup.variants: {n} variants – they differ in package / packaging

locations.intro: Locations can be nested (Cabinet › Drawer › Box). Click a name to list its components – the QR label does the same from a phone.
locations.delete_confirm: Delete location "{name}"? Sub-locations and stock move to: {target}.
locations.print_hint: The QR code opens the component list for that location. The phone must be on the same network as this computer.
locations.qr_address: App address in the QR code
locations.localhost_warning: "localhost" only works on this computer – pick a local network address for phones.

categories.edit_hint: Click a category name to rename it, press Enter to confirm.

settings.api_intro: Enabled services are queried at the same time by "Find online". Keys are stored only in the local database.
settings.test_ok: Works – a test search returned {n} results.
settings.clear_cache_hint: Search results are cached for 24h to save API quota
settings.local_files_intro: Images are saved locally when a component is saved, so they work offline. Datasheets can be saved with the button next to the link.
settings.backup_intro: Database size: {size}. A backup is a complete copy of the database made while the app is running.
settings.restore_hint: Restore: stop the app and replace inventory.db in the data folder (see "About") with the chosen backup file.
settings.lan: On your local network (e.g. from a phone): {urls}
settings.primary_source_hint: When the same part exists at several services, data is taken from this one; the others only fill in what is missing. In the lookup you can still pick another source per field.
settings.key_where: Online lookup needs an API key from Mouser or Element14. You get one by registering for free on their website:
